# Neptune Station Official Server Rules
This is a MRP server, rules are up to standards of the MRP level but at the same time this server is made for player agency meaning you get a lot more freedom than your usual MRP server and even more than some LRP servers.
## STANDARD RULES:
[color=#c7a600][bold]GOLDEN RULE: Admins have the final say over the situation, meaning you still have to follow their word until told otherwise by a higher admin. (any issues may be reported, to change the ruling)[/color][/bold]
[bold]Keep in mind, no lying in ahelps on purpose[/bold]
1. [bold]Standard Of Roleplay[/bold]: This is a MRP server, you have to act like you aren't playing a game if the game itself doesn't tell you to do otherwise. Take RP a bit more seriously.
2.1 [bold]No IRL Bigotry[/bold]: It doesn't matter what color/gender they are, no slurs/hate, this also includes word play on slurs
2.2 [bold]Speciesm is semi-allowed[/bold]: You can be specist aka you can hate on a species but don't try to worsen everyone's experience too much with it (throwing a few insults and so on but no big discrimination), "2.1" no worldplay on already existing slurs for species, make something unique.
3.1 [bold]No metagaming/current round info[/bold]: You aren't allowed to talk about the current round outside the game (this means via messages or calls and etc.) past rounds do not exist in game, only the current round
3.2 [bold]no metagruding (meta-friends are allowed)[/bold]: You are allowed to know people from "past rounds" as friends and so on (do not mention past rounds tho), it would be annoying RPing meeting them again every round. This does not allow metagruding. Any hate and annoyance you developed from past rounds/outside the game mustn't be acted out.
3.3 [bold]No powergaming[/bold]: No gearing yourself/anyone else up with good gear for no good reason.
4.1 [bold]Do not name yourself after real life figures and no low effort names[/bold]: Should be self explanatory. (I can promise you, we don't have a king Von on station killing everyone.)
4.2. [bold]You can reference stuff from real life but keep it calm[/bold]: You still have to act like you aren't playing a game
5 [bold]No ERP[/bold]: There could be minors here, light dating is allowed but only if you know the other person is 18.
6. [bold]No using exploits/hacks and raiding the server[/bold]: Self explanatory
## PLAYER AGENCY RULES:
[bold][italic]Freedom is the key[/bold][/italic]
7. [bold]No station wide destruction before 20 minutes[/bold]: This means command/crew are forced to call the evac.
8.1 [bold]You are allowed to kill people and even RR them with a good enough reason as non antag[/bold]: and I do mean, good reason, no running around "he insulted me once".
8.2 [bold]No RR before the 20 min mark[/bold]: You can still beat up people for a good reason but you must take them to medical before the 20 min mark, since it's annoying getting RRed too early into the round. After the 20 min RR and killing are permitted with a good reason.
9. [bold]Corruption is allowed to a certain degree[/bold]: There are exceptions to this. (look at the command rule section for these.) Command and security doesn't have to follow their SOP but CC or captain, CC officials have to follow SOP and can't be corrupt.
## ANTAG RULES:
[bold][italic] antags get also some freedom[/italic][/bold]
10.1 [bold]Antags are permitted to break away from their tasks[/bold]: For the name of freedom we will allow antags to do whatever gimmick they want
10.2 [bold]no mindless murderbone[/bold]: Antags aren't allowed to murder the entire station for no reason without the DADG (die a glorious death) task, with that you can murder anyone with no drawbacks.
10.3 [bold]any pacified antag (thief for example) or antag whose interests aren't to affect the station (abductor for example) aren't allowed to murder/RR[/bold]: Makes sense RP wise.
## COMMAND RULES:
[bold]Corrupting isn't forced, it's up to you, do you wanna be corrupt or keep the station in order[/bold]
11. [bold]Command and security must act in the interest of the station and the crew[/bold]: Meaning they can be corrupt, take bribes and items, etc. but can't go out of their way to make the station worse. (They may still be reported for demotion).
12. [bold]HOS/warden must enforce/add the perma system fairly, despite being corrupt[/bold]: So the system would stay balanced since it carries over from rounds.
## SILICON/FAMILIAR RULES: [bold]It's not slavery trvst[/bold]
13.1 [bold]Silicons must follow their laws in order. Self explanatory[bold]:
13.2 [bold]Familiars must follow the orders from their owner/boss[/bold]: Do not on purpose bend what your owner/boss said, try to take it at face value, so you don't overdo.
